name: Comfort UI
author: Local UI Workshop
description:
Comfort UI 0.5.1: 13 languages, scrollable language lists, Korean font selection, direct camera close, hover and desktop layout repairs, optional Orbit burst motion and microphone style recovery. Includes the prior 0.5.0 language update.

367 managed, 78 isolated browser and 32 camera static checks pass; these are not real-client/VR certification. Some low-frequency translations need native-speaker review. User-authorized public preview.

Installer: https://github.com/xuan5636/ChilloutVR-ComfortUI/releases/download/v0.5.1/ComfortUI-Setup-0.5.1.exe
Release notes and feedback: https://github.com/xuan5636/ChilloutVR-ComfortUI/releases/tag/v0.5.1

Unofficial mod, not affiliated with, approved, verified or supported by ChilloutVR or Alpha Blend Interactive. Modifications may affect performance, security or stability.
requirements: Windows x64 and .NET Framework 4.8; local model download is optional. See repository installation and translation documentation.
changelog: 0.5.1: combines 13-language support with scrolling/Korean, camera close/hover/desktop layout, a fourth motion style and microphone style recovery. Source, DLL, EXE and checksums available on GitHub.
